Looking at the figure, the semicircle is centered at the origin (0, 0).

- The curve intersects the x-axis at x = -7 and x = 7.
- The top of the curve reaches y = 7 on the y-axis.

The distance from the center (0, 0) to any point on the curve (e.g., (7, 0), (0, 7), or (-7, 0)) is 7 units.

Radius = 7 units
